target.title: fix(sessions): reply session init fails under rapid consecutive turns
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users sending several messages in quick succession to the same session (TUI, webchat, and other channels) would occasionally see the turn fail outright with `Error: reply session initialization conflicted for <sessionKey>`, instead of getting a reply. This is user-visible and requires the user to retry manually.

## Why This Change Was Made

`initSessionState` commits reply-session state via `commitReplySessionInitialization`, which uses an expected-revision guard to detect concurrent writers to the same session-store file. On a revision mismatch it retried exactly once (`staleSnapshotRetried`) before throwing. Under a burst of rapid consecutive turns on the same `sessionKey`, one retry was not always enough to win the race, so the error surfaced directly to the end user — even though each retry re-reads a fresh, correctly-serialized snapshot (via the same writer lane / `runExclusiveSessionStoreWrite` queue) and a further attempt would very likely succeed.

This change raises the retry ceiling from 1 retry (2 attempts total) to a small bounded budget (4 attempts total), replacing the boolean `staleSnapshotRetried` flag with a numeric `attempt` counter. It does not change any locking, snapshot, or commit semantics, and the final failure mode (throwing after the budget is exhausted, so a genuinely stuck/corrupt session store is still surfaced) is unchanged. The change is scoped entirely to `src/auto-reply/reply/session.ts`; none of the touched functions are exported or referenced elsewhere.

## User Impact

Users sending quick back-to-back messages to the same session (e.g. several tool-invocation requests in a row) will no longer see spurious `reply session initialization conflicted` failures for turns that would have succeeded on a subsequent attempt. No behavior changes for the non-conflict path, and a truly stuck session store still fails loudly after exhausting the (now larger) retry budget rather than retrying forever.

## Evidence

Reproduced on OpenClaw 2026.6.11 via the TUI channel: sending 2-3 curl requests back to back intermittently threw this error while the gateway log showed the session's own record settling to `status: "done"` immediately after, confirming the conflict was transient rather than a corrupted session.

Validated the fix against the existing test suite (no test changes needed):
- `npx vitest run src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts` — 126/126 passed
- `npx vitest run extensions/telegram/src/polling-session.test.ts` — 73/73 passed (this suite specifically exercises `"reply session initialization conflicted for ..."` as a retryable error at the channel layer, confirming the message/shape contract is preserved)
- `npx oxlint src/auto-reply/reply/session.ts` — clean
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.core.json` — no new errors (one pre-existing, unrelated `TS4058` error in `src/secrets/config-io.ts` reproduces identically on `main` without this change)
